race.comment: IDEN OLIVER (2) finished fourth last start, beaten 13 metres at this track over 2090m. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. Tackles a similar assignment and he can play a major role in the outcome. IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (6) was far from disgraced at her latest appearance over 1680m at Launceston, beaten just 3 metres into fourth. This should be an easier assignment so she is a major player. LIKEABLE ROGUE (5) is in the mix following a respectable second at his most recent appearance over 1680m at Launceston. Worth an each-way ticket. CUZZY JUNIOR (1) is next best and gets every chance from a favourable draw.
